items.title: Randy Sandke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: I wrote three things: an arrangement of Ellington-Strayhorn tunes which will be on this record

ctx.x: Is that where you did the arrangements on the Bach?

Well there’s one piece that’s kind of from that. But the first symphony concert that Ken Peplowski and I did we did, I wrote three things: an arrangement of Ellington-Strayhorn tunes which will be on this record; and then this version of the Brandenburg, I mean the Goldberg variations, where the orchestra would play a variation and then the jazz quintet would do a variation on the same material; and also this other piece which is on the record which is just kind of contemporary classical music. I like to write,…
It reminds me of Ornette Coleman’s—
